title: bigbio/sdrf-agentic-annotator pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

pxd.errorMessage: PXD accession must be 'PXD' followed by six digits, for example PXD074155

ref_sdrf.description: Optional absolute path to an existing, already-published SDRF to refine (refine mode only). When empty, the pipeline fetches the existing SDRF from bigbio/sdrf-annotated-datasets by PXD.
ref_sdrf.errorMessage: ref_sdrf, when provided, must be an existing absolute path to a .sdrf.tsv file
